title: Sugestão de melhoramento
body:
Considero que a aplicação quando usada como lista. Ou seja com icons de verificação de tarefa realizada.
Essa linha devia ficar riscada ou mudar o posicionamento para o fim da lista. Acho que ficar só com o certo e preenchimento amarelo não é vantajoso pois como não acontece nada ao texto quando se lê faz confusão, pois tem de se olhar para o inicio! O meu exemplo mais concreto é tenho uma lista de restaurantes e gostava que se aplicassem as sugestões para um melhor controlo de quais foram ou não visitados.

title: Essential app keeps getting better
body:
I use this app extensively after transferring all my Evernote notes to Apple Notes. I have about 200 notes organised in folders. This app makes it easy to create notes from any app on my iPhone , iPad, or Mac. Then, they are easy to find, to organise in folders, and easy to manipulate. If you save a web link, Notes makes lovely previews. It’s a pleasure to use. I back up my notes as exported PDF, the links work. This app is essential. I’m glad that Apple keeps improving it.
Areas for improvement: searching tags should highlight the precise location in a note to increase its usefulness. Tables can become more flexible, like tiny spreadsheets. Streamline the usability of the folders.
author: Alex.V.64

title: Almost perfect, fatally flawed
body:
Usability wise, it’s nearly perfect for me, simple and powerful enough - 5 stars.

The lack of some easy way to export notes is almost criminal.. 1 star.

Being able to take notes on the go is one of the advantages of _having_ a smartphone, but having to put personal notes on the cloud or send them by email just to save them on the computer feels like a bad joke.
